data.title: Ethereum falls 16% in October as US ETH ETFs se... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's price dropped 16.06% in October 2026 after three months of gains, closing around $2,250. US spot Ethereum ETFs experienced a historic $1.61 billion in net outflows, mainly from BlackRock's ETHA fund with $1.42 billion withdrawn. This decline coincided with broader market concerns including a Binance hack and slowing institutional purchases. November's market will be closely watched to see if investor confidence and ETF inflows recover.
data.author: Cointribune
